name: playcanvas-polygon-streaming-standalone-plugin
description: Option 2 of the Polygon Streaming PlayCanvas SDK. Integrating Polygon Streaming into PlayCanvas via the Standalone Plugin (polygon-streaming.js script asset uploaded into the PlayCanvas Editor). For projects NOT publishing to VIVERSE and not using a bundler.
prerequisites: PlayCanvas engine v1 or v2 (loaded via <script> or the PlayCanvas Editor)
Ability to upload polygon-streaming.js as a script asset in the PlayCanvas Editor
Basis Library imported in the PlayCanvas project (Settings → Rendering → IMPORT BASIS)
